title: 雪崩光二極體製作
summary: 從吸收與倍增、暗電流來源到偵測系統：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Absorption and multiplication and Dark-current sources to Detection system: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 吸收與倍增 → 場形塑
stages.titleEn: Absorption and multiplication to Field shaping
stages.description: 把「吸收與倍增」「線性模式」「場形塑」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Absorption and multiplication, Linear mode, Field shaping.

steps.title: 吸收與倍增：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Absorption and multiplication: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements.
steps.instruction: 畫吸收區與高電場倍增區，追蹤一對光生載子。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw absorption/multiplication regions and track a photogenerated pair. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求；電子和電洞游離率可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements; Electron and hole ionization rates can differ.
steps.failure: 若採用「把整個元件都畫成相同高場」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Drawing uniform high field throughout the device", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「吸收與倍增」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Absorption and multiplication diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements.

knowledge.titleEn: Absorption and multiplication / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 機制：光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements.

knowledge.title: 吸收與倍增／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Absorption and multiplication / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把整個元件都畫成相同高場」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Drawing uniform high field throughout the device.

quiz.question: 關於「吸收與倍增」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Absorption and multiplication, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求
把整個元件都畫成相同高場
APD 有增益便必須工作在崩潰以上
optionsEn: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements
Drawing uniform high field throughout the device
quiz.explanation: 光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 吸收與倍增：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Absorption and multiplication: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把整個元件都畫成相同高場」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Drawing uniform high field throughout the device.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「吸收與倍增」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把整個元件都畫成相同高場」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：電子和電洞游離率可能不同。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Absorption and multiplication artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Drawing uniform high field throughout the device". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Electron and hole ionization rates can differ. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求；電子和電洞游離率可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements; Electron and hole ionization rates can differ.
steps.failure: 若採用「把整個元件都畫成相同高場」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Drawing uniform high field throughout the device", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「吸收與倍增」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「電子和電洞游離率可能不同」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Absorption and multiplication, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Electron and hole ionization rates can differ" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 吸收與倍增／物理與模型

knowledge.text: 診斷機制：電子和電洞游離率可能不同。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Electron and hole ionization rates can differ.

knowledge.title: 吸收與倍增／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Absorption and multiplication / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把整個元件都畫成相同高場」與「光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Drawing uniform high field throughout the device" is not equivalent to "Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.title: 線性模式：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「線性 APD 增益與 Geiger 觸發不同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Linear APD gain differs from Geiger triggering.
steps.instruction: 在增益對偏壓曲線標出崩潰前工作範圍。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the pre-breakdown operating region on a gain-bias plot. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 線性 APD 增益與 Geiger 觸發不同；串聯電阻會改變接面實際偏壓。
steps.observationEn: Linear APD gain differs from Geiger triggering; Series resistance changes actual junction bias.
steps.failure: 若採用「APD 有增益便必須工作在崩潰以上」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming gain requires above-breakdown operation", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「線性模式」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：線性 APD 增益與 Geiger 觸發不同。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Linear mode diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Linear APD gain differs from Geiger triggering.

knowledge.title: 線性模式／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：線性 APD 增益與 Geiger 觸發不同。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Linear APD gain differs from Geiger triggering.

knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Assuming gain requires above-breakdown operation.

線性 APD 增益與 Geiger 觸發不同

quiz.explanationEn: Linear APD gain differs from Geiger triggering. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 線性模式：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「APD 有增益便必須工作在崩潰以上」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Assuming gain requires above-breakdown operation.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「線性模式」成果，先指出錯誤主張「APD 有增益便必須工作在崩潰以上」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：串聯電阻會改變接面實際偏壓。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Linear mode artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Assuming gain requires above-breakdown operation". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Series resistance changes actual junction bias. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 線性 APD 增益與 Geiger 觸發不同；串聯電阻會改變接面實際偏壓。
steps.observationEn: Linear APD gain differs from Geiger triggering; Series resistance changes actual junction bias.

steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming gain requires above-breakdown operation", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「線性模式」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「串聯電阻會改變接面實際偏壓」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Linear mode, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Series resistance changes actual junction bias" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.
